Name: Slime Hutch to Winery (Casks Enabled)
Author: Richarizard
Description:
[center][img]https://imagizer.imageshack.com/v2/584x46q90/922/w90aXW.png[/img][/center]﻿

Inspired by the beautiful Winery building included in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4542]Medieval buildings[/url] mod by Gweniaczek, this mod tries to make the Slime Hutch function as a fully fledged Winery, allowing you to place casks and age products. This mod includes a vanilla style sprite replacement for the Slime Hutch, so Gweniaczek's mod is not required, but it is recommended!

If you like the asset but don't want to replace the Slime Hutch, I've created an alternate version of this mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14704]New Building - Winery[/url], which will add the Winery as an entirely new and seperate building.




[center][img]https://imagizer.imageshack.com/v2/584x46q90/924/DJEO82.png[/img][/center]

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI﻿[/url]﻿.
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher﻿[/url]﻿.
[*]Extract into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/font].
[*]Run the game through SMAPI to generate a [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file, and then close the game.
[*]Edit the config file in a text editor, and configure the mod to your tastes. Carefully read the Configuration section below, and use it to guide you.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]



[center][img]https://imagizer.imageshack.com/v2/584x46q90/923/g13sAg.png[/img][/center]

[font=Courier New]AdjustedCost: [b]True[/b], False[/font]
Toggle whether you'd like the building costs for the Slime Hutch to be adjusted to make more sense for the Winery. This would remove the need for Refined Quartz and an Iridum Bar.

[font=Courier New]Layout: Original, [b]Adjusted[/b], Expanded[/font]
Sets the size of the Winery interior. [font=Courier New]Adjusted[/font] allows for a more optimal layout of Casks/Kegs over the original Slime Hutch size. [font=Courier New]Expanded[/font] doubles the size of the interior. [font=Courier New]Original[/font] is there for if you don't want any changes to be made to the size of the interior, despite the uneven layout of Casks you will need to use. 

[font=Courier New]Style: Stone, Wood, [b]Panelled[/b][/font]
Sets the wall tiles of the Winery interior.

[font=Courier New]ReplaceBuildingSprite: [b]True[/b], False[/font]
Toggle whether you'd like to replace the default Slime Hutch sprite with a new Winery sprite. This should be set to false If you are using a slime hutch replacement from another mod, such as the Winery (Slime Hutch option 3) from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4542]Medieval buildings[/url] by Gweniaczek.

[font=Courier New]ReducedFootprint: True, [b]False[/b][/font]
Toggle whether you'd like to reduce the footprint of the building so it's not so massive, and better matches the Winery sprite (Only applicable when [font=Courier New]ReplaceBuildingSprite[/font] is set to [font=Courier New]true[/font]).
[b][color=#cc0000]WARNING: Changing this will not alter the footprint of any existing Slime Hutches/Wineries in your save game. This may cause anomalies with collisions and the Winery in your save game.[/color][/b]

[font=Courier New]RoofColour: [b]Green[/b], Blue, Red[/font]
Sets the colour of the roof on the replacement Winery sprite (Only applicable when [font=Courier New]ReplaceBuildingSprite[/font] is set to [font=Courier New]true[/font]).




[center][img]https://imagizer.imageshack.com/v2/584x46q90/923/fVK7Ks.png[/img][/center]﻿

This mod will [b]not[/b] be compatible with any mods which alter the interior of the Slime Hutch. Other than that, there should be no problems running this mod with any others.
